BMI_Clinical_Note: BMI <18.5 — Energy & protein repletion required. High nutritional risk.
Waist_Risk_Indian: Central Obesity (≥80 cm — Indian Women Threshold)
Hormone_Therapy: No Hormone Therapy (TNBC — ER-, PR-, HER2-)
Bone_Density_Concern: HIGH — Bone metastasis risk. Bisphosphonates/Denosumab. Calcium + Vit D. Low-impact exercise only.
Nutrition_Impact_Symptoms: Anorexia/Poor Appetite; Bone Pain (Metastasis); Cachexia; Early Satiety; Fatigue; Insulin Resistance; Weight Loss
Fat_Carb_Ratio_Note: High fat:Low carb — insulin resistance [ESPEN B2-3]
Vitamin_D_IU_per_day: 400 IU/day (ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA) — sunlight 15–20 min/day also essential
Calcium_mg_per_day: 600 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA) — dietary calcium from dairy/ragi/sesame preferred
Zinc_mg_per_day: 10 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) — important for immune function + wound healing
Dietary_Fibre_g_per_day: 40 g/day (ICMR-NIN 2020); reduce to 25 g if diarrhoea/mucositis
Omega3_Recommendation: 2–3 g EPA/DHA/day — fish oil supplement [ESPEN B5-7]
Protein_Source_Note: Protein: eggs (2/day) + dal + paneer + curd + legumes + soya
Alcohol_Guidance: ZERO alcohol — carcinogen; increases BC recurrence risk [ESPEN C5-2]
ICMR_NIN_2020_Reference: ICMR-NIN Nutrient Requirements & RDA for Indians (2020 revision)
Nutrition_Route_ESPEN: Comfort oral (Indian home-cooked preferred); EN/PN only if prognosis >2 months + QoL benefit [ESPEN C6-2]
Supplement_Recommendation: ONS 1–2x/day: Pentasure HP / Ensure Plus / Fresubin Energy / Disprolene (Indian brands preferred); Calcium 600 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA) + Vitamin D 400 IU/day + 15–20 min daily sunlight; Iron 19–29 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) — monitor Hb; IV iron if <8 g/dL on chemo; Folate 220–400 mcg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020; higher during chemo); Ground flaxseed 1–2 tbsp/day (lignans — phytoestrogen modulation; beneficial ER+ Indian BC survivors); Megestrol Acetate / short-term Corticosteroid — physician-prescribed [ESPEN B5-1/B5-2] (note DVT risk with megestrol in Indian patients); Multivitamin/mineral at RDA dose ONLY (ICMR-NIN 2020). NOT high-dose. Avoid selenium, Vit E, Vit C megadoses during chemo.
Exercise_Plan_ESPEN_India: Gentle daily walk (10–20 min) / seated yoga; comfort prioritised [ESPEN B4-1]
ESPEN_Guidelines_India: 📋 SCREENING [B1-1]: Regular nutritional assessment from diagnosis. Indian BC patients — ICMR/WHO Asian BMI cut-offs apply (Normal: 18.5–22.9; Overweight: ≥23; Obese: ≥25). [South India (Tamil Nadu/Karnataka/Kerala/Andhra)] | 📋 ASSESSMENT [B1-2]: PG-SGA score elevated → quantitative assessment: 24-hr dietary recall, muscle mass (BIA/DEXA/mid-arm circumference), grip strength, CRP/albumin, NIS. | ⚡ ENERGY [B2-1]: 25–30 kcal/kg/day (ESPEN). Indian context: average Indian BC woman body weight 55–65 kg. Total: 1400–2000 kcal/day depending on stage and activity. | 🥩 PROTEIN [B2-2]: >1 g/kg/day (ESPEN); ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA: 0.83 g/kg/day (healthy); BC treatment: 1.0–1.5 g/kg/day. Vegetarian patients: dal+rice+dairy combination essential for complete amino acid profile. | 🔄 SUBSTRATE [B2-3]: Insulin resistance (common in obese Indian BC patients) → ↑ fat, ↓ refined carbohydrate, prioritise low-GI foods (millets, whole grains, legumes). | 💊 MICRONUTRIENTS [B2-4 + ICMR-NIN 2020]: Vitamin D (endemic deficiency in India — 400–1000 IU/day), Calcium (600–1200 mg/day from ragi/dairy/sesame), Iron (19–29 mg/day), Folate (220–400 mcg/day). AVOID high-dose antioxidants during chemo. | 🚨 NUTRITION [B3-1]: IMMEDIATE intervention. ONS (Pentasure/Ensure/Fresubin); escalate to EN if oral <50% target >1 week. | ⚠ INTERVENTION [B3-2]: No unproven restrictive diets. Beware of social media misinformation about 'anti-cancer' diets in Indian context. | 🏥 MEDICAL NUTRITION [B3-3]: EN preferred (nasogastric/PEG); PN if EN not feasible. | ⚠ REFEEDING [B3-4]: Slow reintroduction if prolonged malnutrition. Monitor PO4, K+, Mg2+. Vitamin B1 200–300 mg/day. | 🔴 TNBC [Indian]: High incidence in young premenopausal Indian women. Aggressive chemo → highest nutritional risk. Protein priority 1.5–2.0 g/kg/day. Anti-inflammatory diet. Immunotherapy GI AE management. | 🕊 PALLIATIVE [C6-1–C6-3]: Comfort-based Indian foods. No restrictive rules. Family/caregiver involvement in food decisions important in Indian cultural context. Home-cooked preferred. Spiritual/cultural food preferences respected. | 💊 APPETITE [B5-1/B5-2]: Short-term corticosteroids or megestrol acetate (physician-prescribed). Note: megestrol — DVT risk; monitor in Indian patients with higher thrombosis predisposition. | 🏋 EXERCISE [B4-1/B4-2]: Aerobic + resistance training recommended. Yoga as adjunct for Indian patients (evidence for fatigue, QoL, cortisol reduction). Lymphedema: progressive resistance IS SAFE. | ❌ BEWARE: High-dose supplement marketing targeting Indian cancer patients (social media/WhatsApp) — vitamin megadoses, 'cancer-curing' supplements, unproven herbal products — not recommended without oncologist approval [ESPEN B2-4].
Diet_Chart_Indian_Meal_Plan: 🌅 Breakfast: Small portions of favourite Indian comfort foods; warm dalia/khichdi/idli if tolerated; 1 cup chai (weak) or herbal tea || 🕙 Mid-Morning: Favourite sips — coconut water, thin chaas, nimbu pani; small fruit if appetite permits || 🍽 Lunch: Soft khichdi or curd-rice or favourite dal-rice; small portions; texture modified if needed; home-cooked preferred || 🕓 Snack: Whatever is desired; cold foods often preferred; custard/dahi/fruit as tolerated || 🌙 Dinner: Light khichdi or vegetable soup + soft roti/bread; warm haldi doodh if tolerated || 🌛 Bedtime: Warm water/milk as desired; comfort-based only || 🕊 PALLIATIVE [ESPEN C6-3]: No restrictive dietary rules. Comfort and dignity are the goals. Small amounts of favourite foods provide emotional comfort. PN unlikely to benefit unless prognosis >2 months. || ✅ UNDERWEIGHT: Fortify ALL Indian meals: add ghee/coconut oil (1 tsp extra), milk powder (2 tbsp) to dalia/oats, peanut chutney, til laddoo, dry fruits. Commercial ONS 2x/day. Target +0.5 kg/week. Khova/mawa laddoo or high-calorie kheer if well tolerated. || 🔴 TNBC (Indian): Higher prevalence in young Indian women (<40 yrs). Highest metabolic demand. Protein 1.5–2.0 g/kg/day mandatory during chemo. Anti-inflammatory diet: haldi, adrak, omega-3, berries, green tea. Immunotherapy patients: watch for immune-related colitis — low-residue if GI symptoms. || ❌ STRICTLY AVOID [ALL INDIAN BC PATIENTS]: Alcohol, tobacco (paan/gutka), vanaspati/dalda (trans fats), excess ghee in obese patients, maida/refined flour products, packaged namkeen/biscuits, sugar-sweetened drinks (even fruit juice), raw/undercooked meat/eggs during chemo. || 🐟 OMEGA-3 FOR VEGETARIANS: Ground flaxseed (1–2 tbsp/day) + walnuts (5–7/day) + mustard oil for cooking + algae-based DHA supplement (250–500 mg/day) — essential since no fish intake. || 🏃 YOGA + EXERCISE [ESPEN B4-1/B4-2]: Brisk walk 45 min/day + yoga (reduces cortisol/fatigue, improves QoL in Indian BC survivors) + resistance 2–3x/week. Reduces BC recurrence risk significantly.
